scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n web,worker -c blue,green "npm run dev" "npm run worker"
scripts.prestart: npm run db:deploy && npm run db:check
scripts.test:unit: tsx --test lib/__tests__/hardening.test.ts lib/__tests__/homepage-message.test.ts lib/__tests__/nav.test.ts lib/__tests__/leads.test.ts lib/__tests__/marketing-trust.test.ts lib/__tests__/no-em-dash.test.ts lib/__tests__/sanitize-prompts.test.ts lib/__tests__/score-display.test.ts lib/__tests__/nav-active.test.ts lib/audit/__tests__/checks.test.ts lib/audit/__tests__/flow-discover.test.ts lib/audit/__tests__/verify-flags.test.ts lib/audit/__tests__/metadata.test.ts lib/audit/__tests__/judge-rubric.test.ts lib/audit/__tests__/rubric.test.ts lib/audit/__tests__/export-summary.test.ts lib/audit/__tests__/launch-readiness.test.ts lib/audit/__tests__/viewports.test.ts lib/audit/__tests__/screenshot-types.test.ts lib/audit/__tests__/phase1-scans.test.ts lib/storage/__tests__/screenshots.test.ts
scripts.preworker:start: npm run db:deploy && npm run db:check
scripts.db:migrate: DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.local node -r dotenv/config node_modules/.bin/prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.local node -r dotenv/config node_modules/.bin/prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:check: DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.local node -r dotenv/config node_modules/.bin/prisma migrate status
scripts.db:drift: DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.local node -r dotenv/config node_modules/.bin/prisma migrate diff --from-schema-datasource prisma/schema.prisma --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --exit-code
scripts.verify: npm run db:validate && npm run db:check && npm run db:drift && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run brand:hex-guard && npm run ui:drift-guard && npm run seo:guard && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run worker:build
scripts.setup: docker compose up -d && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
